events.q: The original blocks were printed by Jacomet, Paris.
The graphics were first published in 1967 in an edition of 500 copies

events.n: later limited edition (EURO ART) from the rediscovered plates
events.q: Around 1975, the old plates were rediscovered in Jacomet's workshop and a one-off limited edition was made of the six most interesting sheets.

events.who: Mme Rodrigue (Le vent d'Arles) and Picasso's heirs
events.q: The publication was made possible by the kind cooperation of Mme Rodrigue (Le vent d'Arles) and Picasso's heirs.
